propositions: Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay on macOS contributes at least 184.32 seconds to critical path in Gerrit Verify and should move to external integration workflow
ADR 0095 currently mandates real-Pandoc binary for every conversion assertion and must be partially superseded by a new ADR 0096 narrowing that requirement to test execution boundary only
External integration workflow is currently Ubuntu-only and requires a new pandoc-corpus-replay job matrix supporting both ubuntu-latest and macos-latest runners
Three representative live corpus bodies (code_arrow, table, prose) plus compact provenance probes remain in Gerrit Verify with all assertion classes preserved against committed deterministic outputs
Pandoc version drift and platform-specific binary fingerprints must fail fast with deterministic fixture regeneration documented and paired A/B evidence required from implementation
